high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an academic paper titled "Real-Time Reasoning Agents in Evolving Environments." The paper is authored by Yule Wen, Yixin Ye, Yanzhe Zhang, Diyi Yang, and Hao Zhu, with affiliations listed as Tsinghua University, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Georgia Institute of Technology, and Stanford University. The authors are identified as co-leading authors who worked on the project during their internships at Stanford University. The paper's abstract discusses the challenges faced by agents in real-world environments that require both logical and timely judgments.
